$comment: Gate file. Only a human edits it. Add a package to excludePackages only with a reason in the PR and an expiry.

_reasons.$comment: Why each tooling-only license is allowed. Tooling licenses never apply to production dependencies of shipping projects (packages/, projects/, platform/). Human decision, approved by the repo owner.

LGPL-3.0-only.reason: eslint-plugin-sonarjs and @sonarsource/analyzer-commons-configurations (lint tooling, via tooling/eslint-config). Never bundled into shipped code.

PSF-2.0.reason: argparse@3 (lint tooling transitive dependency via tooling/eslint-config).

CC-BY-3.0.reason: spdx-exceptions (license-parsing data package, transitive dependency of lint tooling via tooling/eslint-config).

MIT-0 (runtime).reason: Allowed for runtime dependencies, approved by the repo owner. MIT-0 is MIT without the attribution duty. It is used by aws-lambda-powertools (api-py), which reports 'MIT License; MIT No Attribution License (MIT-0)'.

PSF-2.0 (runtime).reason: Allowed for runtime dependencies, approved by the repo owner. PSF-2.0 is a permissive license. It is used by typing_extensions (api-py, via aws-lambda-powertools and pydantic).

caniuse-lite@1.reason: Named runtime exception, approved by the repo owner. CC-BY-4.0 browser-support data (no code). Transitive production dependency of next (via browserslist) in every Next.js web part. Attribution only. Only major version 1 is excluded; a new major needs a new review.

certifi@2026.reason: Named runtime exception, approved by the repo owner. MPL-2.0 license of the certifi CA bundle, a transitive production dependency of the Python api (api-py). The file-level copyleft of MPL-2.0 covers only the certifi files, which the project does not change. Only major version 2026 is excluded (certifi uses year-based versions); a new major needs a new review.
